create.productIdPrecedence: Controller uses truthy product_id first, otherwise image.product_id. image.image itself is discarded before insert. New TS should refuse two differing nonzero IDs instead of silently choosing conflicting client metadata.
create.uniqueMeaning: Incoming unique is aliased to sku_unique by Request.more param[3]. It is never the new review unique; saveReply overwrites review.unique with PHP uniqid().
create.validation: product_id/avatar/nickname/comment required; reply_score In1,2,3; three scores In1..5. ThinkValidate.in uses non-strict in_array, and must permits string0, so do not infer all string0 text is source-invalid.
create.skuSnapshot: Optional truthy sku_unique fetches getOne(product_id,unique), copying suk to review.sku; missing match becomes empty sku. Source query has no explicit ordinary-SKU type, activity/retired filtering or ambiguity count. Active SPA requires attr.unique selected from product.attrValue(type0).
create.time: PHP empty(add_time) uses current time; otherwise strtotime in Asia/Shanghai; only >now is explicitly refused, so equality now is accepted. Nonempty invalid dates can become false/epoch0 in the source; TS should reject invalid/future dates while preserving imported history. DatePicker on-change supplies a wall-time string.
create.images: Controller receives pics as array and json_encodes it. Max8 is enforced by generated form/custom SPA, not separately by saveReply; implement explicit8 and bounded URL/text validation in TS, with no remote fetch.
create.bodyPolicyProposed: Only proven fields; scalar canonical IDs/score string or number values; Unicode nickname<=64, customer comment<=512, avatar<=255 and SKU snapshot<=255 (original PHP table limits). Reject identity/order/visibility/owner injection and oversized streamed body. Broader TS column capacities are not proof of an expanded old contract.

A claimed race-free live product.star update needs cross-producer locking or a durable per-product refresh consumer with evidence; design/test this rather than assuming the Admin lock proves global aggregation freshness.
